analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI has slightly rebounded after entering oversold territory but remains below 40. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays in negative territory. ADX at 26.8 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (33.6) remains dominant over +DI (15.9), suggesting a persistent weak trend. Volume surged 1.92x the 5-day average, but price is consolidating at the swing resistance of $0.08. ATR is $0.00, making stop-loss placement difficult. No clear signal for directional confirmation.
